svg.title: Candidate Desktop Session, Participation, and Connection trust chain
svg.desc: A Desktop Registration binds a User and Institution to a public key. A DPoP Desktop Session proves that registered key for every request. Admission rechecks current candidate, Sitting, compatibility, configuration, and Session-lock conditions before creating one Participation generation bound to that exact Session and one Connection. Candidate HTTP operations require the DPoP Session, continuity credential, Connection identity, Participation identity, and generation together.
